Selection

This module contains determinant selection algorithms used by selected CI methods.

add_selected_dets

Source: selection.f90:L9-L19

add_selected_dets(sel_method, selected_space, n_sel_space, n_words, old_e, old_c, n_spin_orbs, h, g, epsilon)

Dispatch routine for determinant selection methods.

Based on the selected method, the appropriate selection algorithm is applied to expand the current determinant space.

Parameters

sel_method : character(len=*)

Selection method to apply.

selected_space : integer(kind=8), allocatable, dimension(:,:)

Current selected determinant space.

n_sel_space : integer

Number of determinants currently in the selected space.

n_words : integer

Number of words used to store each determinant.

old_e : real(kind=dp)

Current variational energy.

old_c : real(kind=dp), dimension(:)

Current CI coefficients.

n_spin_orbs : integer

Number of spin orbitals.

h : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:)

One-electron integrals.

g : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:,:,:)

Two-electron integrals.

epsilon : real(kind=dp)

Selection threshold.

Returns

selected_space : integer(kind=8), allocatable, dimension(:,:)

Expanded determinant space.

n_sel_space : integer

Updated size of the selected space.

hci

Source: selection.f90:L22-L119

hci(selected_space, n_sel_space, n_words, old_c, n_spin_orbs, h, g, epsilon)

Performs determinant selection using the Heat-Bath Configuration Interaction (HCI) algorithm.

For each determinant in the current selected space, all connected single and double excitations are generated. Candidate determinants are retained if

\[|H_{ij} c_i| > \epsilon\]

where \(H_{ij}\) is the Hamiltonian coupling between determinants and \(c_i\) is the CI coefficient of the parent determinant.

New determinants passing this screening criterion are added to the selected space.

Parameters

selected_space : integer(kind=8), allocatable, dimension(:,:)

Current selected determinant space.

n_sel_space : integer

Number of determinants currently in the selected space.

n_words : integer

Number of words used to store each determinant.

old_c : real(kind=dp), dimension(:)

CI coefficients from the previous variational calculation.

n_spin_orbs : integer

Number of spin orbitals.

h : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:)

One-electron integrals.

g : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:,:,:)

Two-electron integrals.

epsilon : real(kind=dp)

HCI selection threshold.

Returns

selected_space : integer(kind=8), allocatable, dimension(:,:)

Expanded determinant space containing all selected determinants.

n_sel_space : integer

Updated number of determinants in the selected space.
